chapter: Touring abroad and the future of music
title: Former band members now teaching in universities
summary: Wong notes alumni are now educators; Herman says most educators have professional experience and the movement can only get stronger.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories
